name: Knowii Clarity 101 Workshop
contents: **Complete Clarity Framework** covering all dimensions of life design
How to identify and accept your **Gravity Problems** (the problems you're not willing to have)
Step-by-step process to determine your **Personal Value System**
How to define your **Personal Principles** that guide daily decisions
Creating your **Personal Manifesto**. Your guiding light.
Finding your *Ikigai*. Your life's mission and purpose.
Why non-goals are just as important as goals
*Design Thinking* Process applied to life design
The **12 Favorite Questions** technique to lean into curiosity
**Vision Grid** framework to envision and compare future lives
How to prototype and experiment with life changes safely
Avoiding the Paradox of Choice when making big decisions
Setting priorities across different time horizons
The importance of **emotional intelligence** and gut feelings in decisions
